notes.title: Bad Apple !! in The Colorful Creature
notes.content:
This has been made by devcey, this is his blog on this project that he did for this game, which is incredible, I had to share it! [url=https://infi.land/blog/21]You can check out the blog on infi.land here.[/url]

[previewyoutube=R-6Z2PfNzdQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]How I made 'Bad Apple !! in The Colorful Creature'[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]By devcey[/b][/h3]

Greetings!

If you're reading this blog post, you've most likely seen my video on YouTube where I have recreated the entirety of the music video of Alstroemeria Records' [b]'Bad Apple !!'[/b] (feat. nomico) inside the Level editor of Infiland's game [b]'The Colorful Creature'[/b]. If not, then feel welcome to do so right [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R-6Z2PfNzdQ][b]here[/b][/url]!

With this little blog post I want to explain how I got to the idea of actually doing this and describe all the individual steps of this project. I hope you'll enjoy reading along!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]How did I get this idea?[/h2]

Sometime around late January/early February I had the itch to challenge myself with a little coding project that felt doable. I would still consider myself a fairly novice coder/programmer despite already slightly engaging in those fields for a couple of years by now. I stumbled upon the thought of implementing Bad Apple !! anywhere and upon expanding on this thought, I had decided to notify Infiland that I was going to start working on this. By promising him that I clearly wanted to make sure that I would actually get this done as one of my biggest problems with projects like these is that I don't complete them many times (slight foreshadowing of what is going to happen).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/138742fd280acb836cb4d788923b49c8bff8ef37.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Procedure[/h2]

My rough idea was the following: I would use the [b]Level editor[/b] as it can be used to display a level the size of [b]32x22 blocks[/b]. Since the background is black, black pixels can be displayed with no block, white pixels with white blocks. As simple as that. With a [b]python script[/b] I would somehow generate a [b]valid level file[/b] that can be loaded in the level editor, one for each frame of the video. Then I would load each level after level and speed up a recording of this process.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Preparing the frames[/h3]

I started out with [b]extracting all 6473 frames[/b] from an [b].mp4[/b] file with the music video that I had already downloaded sometime ago. For this I used [b]ffmpeg[/b] and ran this simple command:
[code]ffmpeg -i .\badapple.mp4 frames\frame-%04d.jpg[/code]
This essentially extracts each frame and saves it as a [b].jpg[/b] file in a seperate dictionary called 'frames'. Every frame is appended by a 4 digit number of it's index. E.g.: 0001, 0002, ... 0727, 0728, ... 6472, 6473.
Next up those frames had to be [b]converted to sharp images[/b] that fit on the TCC level editor (32x22px in size), like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/a47eec4056bc7a01e19fe6cd6664d8d4b6ec4ad7.png[/img]
I had modified each frame using [b]ImageMagick[/b]. This process took a lot of trial and error, but these following commands generated what I needed:
[code]
magick.exe mogrify -resize 32x22 *.jpg //Used to simply downscale each image.
magick.exe mogrify -colors 2 -colorspace gray -normalize -format png *.jpg //Used to apply a constrast of 2 grayspace colors, in order to eliminate any gray pixels
[/code]
With this completed, the frames have been prepared.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Converting frames into readable TCC levels[/h3]

Ok slight warning, this may become a little technical.

The next step was to [b]create a script[/b] that would read those frames and create a file resembling the [b]TCC level format[/b]. For this, the algorithm would have to read each pixel and based on its color and position, place a white block or leave it empty.
For this we need to understand the [b]TCC level format[/b] a little:

LevelEditor.sav:
[code]
{"ROOT":[
{"x":448,"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":192},
{"x":448,"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":224},
{"x":480,"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":192},
{"x":480,"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":224}
]}
[/code]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/e13581e94846da23274dc0a97afacf8d228b1edd.png[/img]

Judging by this file (frame-5874) it becomes very clear that the [b]LevelEditor.sav[/b] file is just one big [b].json[/b] file listing each block using their [b]x- and y-coordinates[/b] and the type of object it resembles. Because of this, we just need to write the basic structure into a [b].json[/b] file using our algorithm.

And this is exactly what I did:
[code]
import os
from PIL import Image

frameDirectory = "frames"
jsonDirectory = "json"

for file in os.listdir(frameDirectory):
    jsonFile = open(f"{jsonDirectory}\{file}.json", "w") #create the json and start writing.
    jsonFile.write('{"ROOT":[') #append to the file
    
    frame = Image.open(f"{frameDirectory}\{file}") #instantiate as image

    for x in range(29): //max width. even though its at 32x22, this was set to 29 to keep the aspect ratio!
        for y in range(22): //max height
            pix = frame.load()
            if pix[x,y] >= 100:
                x_coord_int = x*32
                y_coord_int = 64+y*32
                x_coord = str(x_coord_int)
                y_coord = str(y_coord_int)

                #{"x":x-coord,"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":y-coord},
                jsonFile.write('{"x":')
                jsonFile.write(x_coord)
                jsonFile.write(',"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":')
                jsonFile.write(y_coord)
                jsonFile.write('},')
                #print('{"x":', x_coord, ',"obj":"o_whiteblock","y":', y_coord, '},')

    jsonFile.seek(jsonFile.tell() - 1, os.SEEK_SET)
    jsonFile.write('') # Intentionally empty to remove last comma if needed before closing bracket

    jsonFile.write("]}")
    jsonFile.close() #finish writing.
[/code]
It's not the cleanest code but what this file essentially does is to loop through every image in my frames folder, create a valid [b]LevelEditor.sav[/b] for it until there are no frames left to process. For reading the image, I imported [b]PIL[/b] from the Image library. It checks through each pixel using an if-statement which checks for the brightness of the respective pixel. If it is bright enough, an object is added.

There is one bug in this script - if one frame is completely dark (as in, there are no white pixels) then it creates an invalid file. This is because an object is always created with a comma in the end, however this comma must be removed for the last object. So I made the script always remove the last symbol before closing the list of objects. This causes a [b]syntax error[/b] and requires a manual fix. -
Why didn't I add another if-statement regarding the type of symbol the last symbol is? I don't know, I was just lazy, haha.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Looping through all level files[/h3]

What was essentially left was to [b]load all the level files[/b] we just created into The Colorful Creature. At first I would have believed I'd have to create a sort of cursor macro which clicks on the load button and selects the correct level, which would have constantly made the screen darken and light up again.

Fortunately, Infiland stepped in and updated The Colorful Creature JUST for my sake. By adding the [b]CTRL+L shortcut[/b], you can now [b]reload your currently loaded level instantly[/b]. This means that essentially we only need our [b]reload macro[/b] to press CTRL+L and we're good.

So I created load_levels.py:
[code]
import pyautogui #used to mouse click
import shutil
import os
import time

levelDirectory = "json"
tccLevel = r"C:\Users\devcey\AppData\Roaming\The_Colorful_Creature\LevelEditor Files\Badapple\LevelEditor.sav"

pyautogui.keyDown("ctrl")
for file in os.listdir(levelDirectory):
    start = time.time()
    shutil.copy(f"{levelDirectory}\{file}", tccLevel)
    end = time.time()
    elapse = end - start
    time.sleep(0.3 - elapse) # Ensure consistent timing, original value was 0.03, might need adjustment
    pyautogui.typewrite("l")
    #pyautogui.click(955,265)

pyautogui.keyUp("ctrl")
[/code]
What this does is to essentially loop through every [b]LevelEditor.sav[/b] we've created, copy it into the TCC level directory while keeping its name "LevelEditor.sav". While it constantly holds CTRL, it presses L after each paste. In order to keep it constant, a sort of [b]timer[/b] is applied which makes sure the same amount of time passes between two levels, as copying and pasting a level that is 110 bytes small needs less time than one that is 15 kilobytes large.

So all we need to do is to run this file, focus the TCC window and let it do it's job, all while recording our screen. Then we need to edit the recording by [b]speeding it up[/b] to match the original video.

Except, the game would [b]constantly crash[/b]. I've not been able to figure out the issue so what I did is to just redo the level loading process but with starting at a later frame that I've already loaded before.

So by [b]mixing together multiple recordings[/b] and speeding them up, we receive the end result. Please do not look at the clock in my recording :)

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

So there we have it. The music video of [b]Bad Apple !![/b] inside the video game [b]The Colorful Creature[/b]. It's not like this project is intended to save the world, but hopefully someone had a good chuckle about it. I surely did! Goodbye and I'll see you when we get Bad Apple !! in Asteroids++!

A super soundtrack includes all .flp files used for TCC which are files that includes all instruments, melodies and effects in songs, you can change them to your hearts content, make remixes or alternate versions of the songs, or make up your own!

notes.title: Freedom Update - GAME IS OPEN SOURCED
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/09ed0f9d68e153da0338aaea5379559a849d9412.png[/img]

[h1]The Game is NOW Open Sourced![/h1]

No this is not an late april fools joke, this game is now open source.

I have been working on The Colorful Creature on and off by myself for the past 6 years or so. This game is like a child to me and having the game handed out to people to see and improve it further sounds exciting.

I decided to open source the game as a thanks, and I want to continue to further support the game by giving the community a chance to contribute and improve the game.

[url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature]For low attention span people, here's the official public repository![/url] View all of it's secrets! 

[url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md]There's also documentation on how to contribute.[/url]

[url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature/issues]For people who want to report bugs or request features for me or other developers to look at, check the issues tab[/url]

[h2]What does this mean?[/h2]

'Open sourcing' any software/game means that the developer(s) are handing out source code entirely for free. It usually requires a license, there's many to choose from but I've chosen Apache 2.0, it means that you can contribute, modify, distribute, or even sell your own version of TCC. It's a legal procedure if I wanted to make the game available to people but I wanted to go on full lengths.

[h2]Why did you do this?[/h2]

For the longest time, I was working on the game by myself, which isn't an issue, but some things took too long to add because of the systems I've implemented that I want to code-refactor, but that takes even longer!

Considering that the game got a full release, I decided to release the game then because I got all of things added that I wanted, but all of these things can be improved in some way.

With me working on other projects, it's difficult to balance TCC and have time for it, I can work on the game but I don't have as much time especially with college and bigger projects planned. So I decided to give the community a chance, with me working on the documentation and help resolve issues with contributors.

I'll be always with the community to help solve issues but now the community can solve the game for me! We can sort the game out together!

[h2]Is the game going to be free on steam?[/h2]

No, the game won't be free on steam, it's just the source code that is becoming free. But you can take the source code and compile the game yourself for free even if you don't own TCC yourself.

There's examples of games that did this, like Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead where it's sold on steam for 20 euros, but it is free on github.

[h2]How can I help[/h2]

If you don't know how to develop games, or use GameMaker, you don't have to! [url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature/issues/new/choose]Head over to the issues tab where you can request bugs and features.[/url]

However, if you have any experience with GameMaker, or want to add/fix something, [url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md]read the contributing.md file and follow instructions.[/url] The issues with [url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A"good+first+issue"]"good first issue"[/url] are easy to add/fix and can get you on the right track.

[i]Keep in mind that the documentation for contributing is work in progress, many things could change to improve workflow of the game, but it will get easier with time.[/i]

[h2]What is next?[/h2]

From now on, [url=https://github.com/Infiland/TheColorfulCreature/milestones]you can see all plans publicly on github for each major release.[/url] I'll keep adding features but now with the community as well. If you need any help regarding to development of the game, [url=https://discord.gg/SSz5THd]join this discord server.[/url]

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.content:
[h1]"MOD" SUPPORT[/h1]
There's no actual mod support in TCC, however I've opened a private github where people can submit a form and modify the game themselves, but I am thinking to do more things with this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/e03da6ed83cbfb277e1c63a64743fe1d1a7ee4fe.png[/img]

Having access to the github repo means [b]you have access to the entire game's source code[/b], so I'll have to put licenses and rules around to prevent any misbehavior and misuse. But here's the jist of things:
1. You have to OWN TCC on Steam
2. You cannot re-sell the game or post it online for free
3. You can only use this repo to help development or make mods


Sign here if you are interested: https://forms.gle/453GD82sW2PJ6vp5A


The modding is probably going to work by adding new branches for TCC, while the development continues on official TCC branches, I'm still working on this update and the Readme for more explanation on how to open and compile the game
I'm hoping to improve the game contribution for TCC, so I'll be adding additional support for mods as well as improving existing code so people could add things in the game easier.


It is also possible that the modding branch will be obsolete from this point

[h1]CONTROLLER ICONS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/9aa91303bf429e4caa45b3e77167f14669254a47.png[/img]

I added controller icons for Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo Switch so you can know what to press when using a controller. Xbox is the primary choice for playing this game but it will still work with other controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/09520fad34a8c99284ef5370125471430342cb7f.png[/img]

[b]Controller icons are made by Kenney and is credited in credits[/b]

[h1]IMPROVED CODE[/h1]

While it's not fully improved, from now on I plan to improve the entire game's codebase, starting with the customization menu. 1500 lines were removed and 200 new lines were added because of this improvement. I don't want to give other people stress when trying to add new things to the game.

[h3]CODE THAT IS IMPROVED[/h3]

[list]
[*] SAVING/LOADING
[*] CUSTOMIZATION
[/list]

If you have any mods enabled, the save files would not conflict with the modded ones, they will be saved in a separate folder

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/99cd122d623d1c1101c7cdbd71237da6b4f6fc25.png[/img]

All code regarding if the skin/hat/item is locked or unlocked and page switching is now totally managed by one function with 25 lines long, instead of the entire process having 1500 lines.

[h1]IMPROVED CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/h1]

[*] You can now press B to go back in menus with a controller
[*] You can buy hats in hat merchant with a controller
[*] You can customize your character with a controller
[*] You can now surf the web with a controller
[*] You can [do something] with a controller

[b]Welcome to Release 1.1.0! It's focus is on progression and changes to all steam achievements![/b]

[h1]Overhauled Achievements[/h1]
For a while, I was thinking to update the achievements and add brand new ones.

Now, steam doesn't let me add more than 100 achievements to my game. This happens to any game with "Profile Features Limited" on the side of the store page.

The plan is to remove steam achievements that have "Do X amount of things", for example, "Die 10000 times" but instead add something fun like "Beat a week in Calendar" or something, while at the same time, keeping the older achievements still in-game. It's more of a replacement if that makes sense. 

I was also thinking to remove super hard steam achievements like Kaizo and World 7 to encourage players to "100% complete" the game, while at the same time keeping those achievements in-game

[h1]So, what does 100% means for the game now?[/h1]
There is going to be two kinds of 100%s. Steam related and the real 100% completion.

To satisfy speedrunners going for 100%, I'd suggest trying out the steam 100%, because after this update it's likely that the achievements by then won't be changed. As for others who are willing to 100% the game, it would be a very challenging task indeed, but if you pulled it off, hats off to you!

[/list]

[h1][b]IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENTS:[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]Future DLC coming soon:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/5806b90f5fe92a48e6494ed79e927b0e192edfba.png[/img]

A future DLC is coming where the game will include a commentary mode. Commentary mode is a mode where you get to see how the development process of The Colorful Creature went throughout the years and what I've learned throughout development (and believe me, I learned a ton!). 

The developer commentary DLC will be available at the end of this year and will cost 1 euro. To be honest, I hate making stuff like DLC's but I don't want to put like "2500 LEVELS DLC" because that's just plain stupid, all levels are free to play! This mode is entirely optional and you do not have to buy it, only do so if you feel like supporting me.

There will be also two upcoming bundles for TCC:

[b]TCC Deluxe Edition[/b] which will include developer commentary and base game
[b]TCC Ultimate Edition[/b] which will include Base game, game ost AND Dev Commentary

[h2][b]GAME PRICE CHANGES[/b][/h2]
I plan to increase the base game price from 2 euros up to 3 euros, dollars will stay the same but I am still concerned because of the recent USD value increase. Generally, the game will just cost more, but when you ask? Well, it will be somewhere at the end of 2022, or somewhere around Beta 1.9 or the Release 1.0 versions!

[h2][b]Dropping 32-bit support for The Colorful Creature this September[/b][/h2]

I'll be dropping 32bit support for TCC for a couple of reasons, [b]the main reason being that Gamemaker, the game engine I use, will no longer support 32-bit exports from this August.[/b] What I could do is essentially try to stay in the same gamemaker version, but that will mean that the game will miss out on game engine's bugfixes or performance improvements.

32-bit is considered obsolete by many, because 64bit became a standard in 2003. If you have a computer that is like over 20 years old or is very weak, you likely have a 32-bit system, however with android phones, this issue could be very common.

Will this affect you? Most likely not. Windows emulates 32-bit pretty well because of backwards compatibility. Making TCC 64-bit [i]may[/i] give benefits such as surpassing the 2GB memory limit, and other important factors. One thing that won't exactly work is discord API in TCC, since the dll file is 32 bit that is used, this will be fixed soon!

[h2][b]4th year anniversary and Beta 1.9[/b][/h2]
On 3rd September, the game will be on sale for 30% off, including the soundtrack. This will be the BIGGEST SALE yet for The Colorful Creature, with larger sales also happening in the future.

The game will be updated to Beta 1.8.9 (pre-beta 1.9), where the game will include the following features:

- Fixes to the game in general

- Few optimizations (better player/troop code rewrite, more flexibility etc)
- Return for languages with a WAY better flexible system (English, French, Spanish, Italian, Magyar), which also allows you to do custom languages too
- Better Level Editor functionality for mobile

- Adding lesser languages (Portuguese, Czech, Chinese, Ukrainian)

Beta 1.9.3 and onwards - October to December 2022
- Commentary Mode DLC
- Polish up to Release
- Bugfixing until release

Release 1.0 Hopefully December 2022
- From here I'll work on the calendar, further localization and smaller fixes

[h1][b]Final note:[/b][/h1]

[h3]I hope you enjoy or have enjoyed The Colorful Creature and thanks for sticking with my community we have created together. This project has flaws but I taught so much from it and I am glad there are indeed people who are playing the game and having fun. Thank you![/h3]

notes.title: The Future of TCC
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/7f198abf76829202bc8573223b02580d9462a656.png[/img]

In this post I will announce [b]future updates of the game[/b], and it's future support after the full release of the game. Let's get started.

[h1][b]Beta 1.8.X[/b][/h1]

As I said previously, [b]Beta 1.8.X will have most patches, just because the update initially wasn't something I had hoped for.[/b] Nontheless we got great features such as [b]leaderboards, zero gravity, big levels in level editor[/b], and a bunch of quality of life improvements.

However it doesn't end here, because patches will continue:
 
[b]Second thoughts about the calendar: It was probably a mistake.. [/b]it is not a bad feature but it does really slow down the actual progress of the game, plus nobody is really making levels for workshop. The calendar is supposed to be a gamemode where I add user levels to the actual game, but it seems like it is not helping to increase the player count... which I deeply hoped.

The calendar will be still worked on, but sometime later in beta 1.9, and I'll hope for more user levels.

I am planning to add a [b]new challenge related to zero gravity[/b], not sure what difficulty but it will probably be difficulty 2-4. And judging by the name, yes, it will include zero gravity and it's fun mechanics! However I need to fix some bugs regarding the item, because 60 herz players are experiencing major differences between 60hz and 144hz.

Speaking of challenges, [b]I am planning adding a new medal: hardmode medal[/b], where you need to beat challenges in their "hardmode form". Not only that you have limited lives, but levels are way harder than normal. You have a time limit (Just like in Yeah GL difficulty) and if you win you get a black medal and border. This is going to be the final medal for challenges.

[b]Alt paths will be added in main game[/b], and you can find those hidden behind fake walls in the game. Going through them will let you play harder versions of levels, but as a reward you get to beat the game faster, and maybe there will be other rewards.

[b]Wheel overhaul[/b], I plan adding different wheels with different rewards, and removing the "No rewards" slot. I may overhaul code or use the existing one, who knows...

I plan adding a [b]pacifist route[/b], where in it you have a second way of not killing bosses and therefore revealing a second ending. Not sure how thats gonna be performed but I have few ideas for the final boss where if you dont kill anyone troops will help you defeat the King instead of using the gun.

[h1][b]Beta 1.9.X[/b][/h1]

This update is mostly planned to be a polish update, fixing major bugs, perhaps overhauling things like the main menu, adding controller support and etc.

[b]Custom Splash Texts, Hats, Skins and Items, sharable custom endless run modes[/b] are planned to be added

Planning to add the ability for people to upload user made challenges, so you can finally upload more levels at once! You may have to beat the entire challenge to publish it, but we shall see

Controller support would be nice. Few people asked for it so why not? It will just take a while because me as a dev does not use a controller and I am not a console guy, so when i do eventually add it, I would like feedback from people.

[h1][b]Release and long term support[/b][/h1]

When the game gets released, I might stream few TCC streams on twitch, steam or other platforms as celebration. On launch, the game will leave its early access/beta stage and thus the price of the game will INCREASE from 2 euros to 3 (or from 3-4$).

[b]The final thing that will happen after game's release is long term support[/b]. And there are 3 different scenarios of how I will go about this.

[h3][b]If the game is doing well:[/b][/h3]

Then I'll work on the game often with quality updates, such as new features, items, skins, stuff like that.

[h3][b]If the game is doing average:[/b][/h3]

Then there will still be updates, but they will come out much much less frequently

[h3][b]And if the game is doing poorly:[/b][/h3]

Then there will still be no updates, with the exception of bugfixes. Unfortunately, I can't keep developing the game forever if there is no audience for the game.

[h1][b]Mobile Port[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/0ec744c6f985cf13f80e9dce60b25ab8c34f41f6.png[/img]

[b]Rest assured! Mobile port is coming![/b] Specifically Android port because iOS is way harder to port the game and financially its more harsh than steam (100$ a year for App Store on iOS). However there are still a few glitches here and there, mostly crashing, but the general progress is just almost fully working controls and somewhat decent menu navigation.

There will be a special trailer for the mobile version of the game and I am excited to see people finally get hands on it.

[h3][b]Quick Q&A on mobile port:[/b][/h3]

Q: How much will the game cost?
A: Free

Q: Is there any downsides to the mobile port compared to steam version
A: In actuality, mobile port and steam versions are exactly the same... with some exceptions.

Q: Are there going to be ads in the game
A: Yes there will be ads, but I'll try my best to make the game as least annoying with ads as possible, while... well, still keeping ads.

Q: Does my progress from steam carry over to Android
A: No

Q: Will the game have cloud support
A: Likely, but not certain, however as I said, there won't be cross platform compatibility

Q: Does the game have steam features, like workshop support, achievements and leaderboards
A: Google has it's own achievement and leaderboard system, unfortunately, workshop support wont be there.

Q: Can't you just make your own server where people post levels?
A: No, because I am very stupid

[h3][b]That's it for now... Thanks to everyone who supports the game, I appreciate it very much! Hopefully the game's legacy will continue forward![/b][/h3]

Before we start, I have to tell you a story about a person that totally exists in this world, Mark, and the issues he was facing.

[b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]
[h1]Story of Mark[/h1]
[h3]Once upon a time, a guy called Mark has bought The Colorful Creature[/h3]
[h3]He liked the game and wanted to make his own levels[/h3]
[h3]So he drew with his mouse on the canvas[/h3]
[h3]And he published a level that he considered... [b][u]perfection.[/u][/b][/h3]

[h3]However, Mark realized something was wrong... terribly wrong[/h3]
[h3]He forgot to put backgrounds, write narrator text, it was really bad![/h3]
[h3]"Oh ma god!", he said... "I simply forgor!"[/h3]
[h3]Now he has to delete his level from the workshop and reupload it[/h3]
[h3]"What a hassle... I am leaving a negative review on stea-[/h3]

[h1]INFILAND: [u][b]WORRY NOT, I HAVE A SOLUTION! BEHOLD![/b][/u] [/h1]
[b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

Enough rambling, time for patch notes.

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]You can now update your levels in level editor![/b] Finally! (updating old levels is possible, but require a bit of work).
[*] In order to update your level, you must do the following:
[/list][h3] [*] Already published a level
[*] Verify the level again
[/h3]
[list]
[*] When you have 2 or more updates you can switch back and fourth between level updates on steam, useful if you accidently updated a level or something
[*] Tags will automatically update when you update your level, so if you add or remove something, tags will be relevant!
[*] Changed narrator text
[/list]

[h2]For older published levels, how to update them:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Go to local files of the game (%appdata%), find The_Colorful_Creature, and then find your level
[*] Inside your level folder, edit OtherLevelEditor.sav file (in notepad or whatever)
[*] In the file, below [Other LE], put the following things:
[/list][h3] [*]Workshop Level Version="0"
[*]Publish ID="0"[/h3]
[list]
[*] Workshop level version isn't too important, but include it there, however what is important is the "Publish ID" variable. Replace the 0 of Publish ID with the number of your level.
[*] To find out the publish id, go to your level in steam workshop (not in game, on steam), and copy the link, in the link you have the long 10 digit number which is the Publish ID. And done!
[/list]

[h1][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Custom Levels menu should no longer check every 20 frames if there's a new level, it will only check once.
[*] Fixed calendar issues.
[/list]

[h1][b]Other:[/b][/h1]
I am currently making a document about the future of TCC, some exciting announcements and long term support for the game, stay tuned!

[h2][b]Things you can perform with this new engine:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b][/][/b] - Reset all effects
[*] [b][[[/b] - Add a bracket
[*] [b][<name of font>][/b] - Change font (available ones: fnt_classic, fnt_cool1, fnt_cool2 (default), fnt_gamemode, fnt_death, fnt_skip, fnt_secret1, fnt_multiplayerfont, fnt_complete, fnt_mainmenu

[*] [b][<name of sprite>,<image>,<speed>][/b] - Draw a sprite, putting custom frame and speed is not required (you can draw any sprite from the game, totally not op)

[*] [b][fa_right][/b] - Align text to the right

[*] [b][fa_middle][/b] - Align text to the middle
[*] 
[*] [h3][b]Transformation:[/b][/h3]
[*] [b][scale,<factor>][/b] - Scale up text/sprites
[*] [b][slant][/b] - Set text to look "Italic"

[*] [h3][b]Effects:[/b][/h3]
[*] [b][wave][/b] - Adds a wave effect
[*] [b][shake][/b] - Adds a shake effect
[*] [b][wobble][/b] - Adds a wobble effect (rotates back and forth)
[*] [b][pulse][/b] - Adds a pulsing effect (heart beat effect in a way)
[*] [b][wheel][/b] - Text circles by its origin
[*] [b][jitter][/b] - Adds a jitter effect (text scales erratically)
[*] [b][blink][/b] - Adds a blinking effect (Text flashes on/off)
[*] [b][rainbow][/b] - Adds a rainbow effect
[*] [b][cycle,<hue1>,<hue2>,<hue3>,<hue4>] [/b]- Similar to rainbow effect, except you can choose your own colors to cycle through. Limited up to 4 colors!
[/list]

notes.title: TCC Beta 1.8 Change Log (HUGE UPDATE)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/3e813a3f5c5cda6e89281d701ca6a8193a0d8801.png[/img]
[h2][b]Before we start:[/b][/h2]

This version will have a lot of patches in the future, [b]like a lot.[/b] The reason why is because there will be bugfixes but especially new additions like new skins, hats, items, overhauling menus, adding leaderboards, changing levels, complex systems and etc to Beta 1.8.X versions!

You might notice that this update seems small, but it took me a long time to add big levels and the calendar, so to give it back to you guys, there will be patches and new additions to Beta 1.8.X

I also highly recommend [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651680/view/3108044685160366154]reading this first,[/url] because it explains Beta 1.8 a lot.

Be on the lookout for future patches of the game!

[h1][b]Features![/b][/h1]
[h2][b]Main Menu[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the news button in the main menu
[*] Added current players counter
[*] Added credits multiplier, more players = more credits for everyone!
[*] New splash texts
[*] Added items in stats menu
[*] Changed EXP formula in stats
[*] Will add customizable splashtexts in the future
[/list]
[h2][b]Main Game[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The king will now shrink before attempting to jump, telling the player that the king will jump.
[*] Balanced some levels a bit.
[/list]
[h2][b]Level Editor[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added ability to change level size from 32x22 blocks to 100x100 blocks!
[*] Added breakable blocks to level editor
[*] Added a new tag called "Big Level" when uploading big levels
[/list]
[h2][b]Calendar[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/76ef3972e3c40b6f356a8ac9501dbc263694d1d7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added the calendar, which contains 334 levels
[*] Each week (7 levels) are unlocked each week of the month, and when you beat a week then you get a reward.
[*] In each year, the calendar will have 12 skins, 12 hats, 12 items and tons of credits
[/list]
[h2][b]Customizables[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new skin (will add 11 new ones because of calendar in future patches)
[*] Added 6 new hats (will add 11 new ones in future patches)
[*] Added a new customizable option, and those are Items! (will add 11 new ones in future patches)
[*] Items can be also used in multiplayer
[/list]
[h2][b]Other:[/b][/h2]
The game will automatically create the Calendar folder in local files/Save Files/Calendar
in there it will name a folder depending on which version of the calendar you are loading (2022 calendar, 2023 calendar etc)
In the 2022 calendar folder it makes 12 folders for each month
Finally in each folder it creates 4 files (one is for each week) which will be used to check if you have all of the levels beaten. The main point is that all of this is dynamic, no hardcoded values, so I don't have to write code for each year, month, week etc. The game is only provided info what it needs to create by itself :)
totally not a complicated system where it took me hours to make lol

[*] Fixed Spelling issues in narrator text
[*] Fixed troop xray
[*] Fixed level editor UI in big levels
[*] Fixed an issue where if you would set level height to 32x22 then upon loading the level wouldn't be as it is by default
[*] Slight Performance fixes
[*] Fixed impossible/extremely pixel perfect level in January Day 27 (thanks dha)
[*] Fixed decimal cost in wheel when you have more than 1X multiplier
[*] Fixed wheel cooldown infinite money glitch, when you open the wheel up and exit the game, the cooldown would be always 10 minutes, now it will only set itself to 10 minutes while the wheel is spinning
[*] Fixed blocks disappearing in big levels in level editor
[*] Fixed issues with settings displaying wrong info
[*] Fixed Local Multiplayer issues with skins and hats being locked.
[*] Fixed a ton of crashes (Fixed MAJOR crash in level editor where you would load a certain Beta 1.8 variable within a Beta 1.7.X instance.)
[*] Fixed breakable blocks in local multiplayer
[*] Fixed countdown timer in Funmode (was one day off)
[*] Fixed level verification issues
[*] Fixed difficulty up/down visual glitch in endless run
[*] Slightly better performance with collision
[*] Fixed "Press [40] to buy something" issue
[*] And more that I forgor myself
[/list]

[h1][b]What will be done in future Beta 1.8.X versions:[/b][/h1]

notes.title: TCC Beta 1.8 News! What to expect?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/2cfcaf61772e38736618ee763f45f57bfe44bc55.png[/img]

[h2][b]Where were we...[/b][/h2]

Around 3 months ago, I've released TCC Beta 1.7 on Steam, which was a great update which added steam related stuff like workshop support, steam achievements and other features like new skins, fourth and fifth boss, graphical improvements to menus, backgrounds and particles and so on.

After the amazing update, I've took my time to also work on patching the game with bugfixes, as well as adding new skins, challenges and the wheel.

This is all great and all [u][b]but there is a huge problem[/b][/u], and that is [u][b]replayability of the game.[/b][/u]
It's not like the game does not have replayability value, you have skins, the credits machine in the main game, hardmode, challenges, hat merchant, achievements, workshop etc. But there do exist people who don't care about getting all medals from challenges, who don't care about hardmode, or are not interested in getting achievements, skins and hats. [u][b]They may only care about beating levels.[/b][/u] So how can we make a system that rewards players for only playing levels but also making it as encouraging?

Well here is my plan that I had in mind for MONTHS now that I am hoping for it to work, and I had it all prepared up:

[h1][b]INTRODUCING THE CALENDAR![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/76ef3972e3c40b6f356a8ac9501dbc263694d1d7.png[/img]

[b]The calendar is the next huge feature that will change TCC replayability value forever in the game[/b] and hopefully get players to more frequently play and enjoy the game.

[h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2]

Upon loading the game, you can find the calendar in fun mode, when entering the calendar, you will see a menu that has months from January to December. When you click one of the months, [b]this is where the fun begins...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/05e78316537c6bc4fbb42099826514543be353c5.png[/img]

[b]Each MONTH has 4 WEEKS and a WEEK has 7 levels.[/b] Upon completing a WEEK, you will unlock a reward that is displayed at the right side of the screen. Each actual day that passes in realtime, a new level gets unlocked and the levels are chosen from the steam workshop of the game and then also used in Endless Run later. [b]The rewards that you can get from weeks are skins, hats, credits and items[/b] (I'll talk about items later).

[h2][b]If you do the math, each month has 28 levels, meaning an entire calendar has a whopping:[/b][/h2]
[h1][b]334 NEW LEVELS![/b][/h1]

And that is all in just one update! Not only that, since there is 48 weeks in the calendar, then there is 48 rewards. So if you finish the entire calendar you can get 12 skins, 12 hats, 12 items and a huge amount of credits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/3a48820a1a48ea7a71aa2527029261f1dc2fdd86.png[/img]

Well if that doesn't excite you I don't know what will....

Now before I move on, I do want to warn that the calendar has a paywall of 1000 credits. Again, I want to repeat that the game doesn't and will not have microtransactions at all, so everyone gets the same amount of credits when playing the game. This paywall is added to, again, encourage replay value, while also having their credits spent on something and keep the newer players away from harder levels.

Don't worry! If 1000 credits sounds like a lot (which it is). I added a dynamic system which decreases the price of the paywall overtime. So by the end of 2022, the cost will be down dynamically by 500 credits, and by the end of 2023, 250 credits.

[h1][b]BIG LEVELS IN LEVEL EDITOR[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/e5868fee856251ffc9047af96ba7597e4f8275ae.png[/img]

[b]This was a highly, very highly requested feature,[/b] and I am happy to report that yes, [b]you can indeed now make big levels in The Colorful Creature Beta 1.8[/b]. This is opening so much level combinations, its probably now in billions. 

Regardless, I've limited the levels to how much big they can actually scale to (for performance, level length and level quality reasons), and its from 32x22 blocks (default value) to 100x100 blocks, it might not sound like much but remember that you can fit over 9 default sized levels within 100x100 block space.

[h3][b]Also, this was HIGHLY REQUESTED. [/b][/h3]
[b]I am adding a item menu[/b] so you don't have to constantly scroll and keep finding what you need.

[h1][b]NEW WAY TO CUSTOMIZE![/b][/h1]

Since I am adding the calendar, there needed to be something special in the calendar. Yes sure, you had rewards like credits, skins, hats, but what else could be added?

[b][h3]Introducing items![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/7085dc548eb163ba83d9eca605528da5c9986619.png[/img]
Items are a third way to customize your player. Reddie will swing the item when he is moving. They only exist in the calendar for now, but may appear elsewhere in the future!

Oh yea, you can use those in local multiplayer

[h1][b]THE USUAL[/b][/h1]

[b]Of course as usual, we will be also adding:[/b]
- More skins
- More hats
- Bugfixes
- New challenges
- Secrets :)
- Settings
- General Game Improvements
- And more!

[h1][b]THE GOAL OF BETA 1.8[/b][/h1]

I am hoping, really hoping to get more people into the game with this update and finally get to play it. [b]The version is around 30% complete.[/b]

So when is it coming out you might be asking? Well... [u][b]in 2 weeks.[/b][/u]
[b]You might think that this is a really bad idea.[/b] Considering Beta 1.7 was out for 3 months and only getting 30% done, and getting to 100% done is impossible by 2 weeks.

[h3][b]This is all true. But in truth....[/b][/h3]
I am making useful sacrifices for the version to come out early.

For example: The Calendar doesn't really have 334 levels, I only made around 35 so far. The Calendar doesn't have 48 rewards, it only has 4. And the reason why that is the case is because other months are not unlocked so therefore you can't play the rest of 304 levels or get the other 44 rewards on the first day. We all know that its an impossible task for me to finish all of the levels and rewards in 2 weeks and what I did is I've made an unlocking system which hopefully saves me time and hassle.

The Level Editor in it's current state is not fully ready yet, as there are bugs and issues with saving/loading big levels. But of course by the time the game is near deadline, these issues will be fixed.

Currently, my solution to make things work is to prioritize the most important things before an update comes. And then once fixed, you won't even notice the behind the scenes work.

And finally, behind the scenes, I actually started working on Beta 1.8 around when Beta 1.7.3 came out, so it not like I worked barely on it

It is very bad to have crunch time and work on a lot useless featues for a short period of time, so everything has to be prioritized and planned how it should.

But anyway, I hope you are excited as I am. And I think we will be all getting more frequent, meaningful updates. There's still time to get everything done, I'll try making a worthwhile update.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/93f478847591d598ad4185595b7e4dc3a44438a7.png[/img]

Prior to this version, workshop support was partial, because of the fact that you couldn't play workshop levels, but only upload/download them. Well now you can!

[h2][b]Features:[/b][/h2]
- Added FULL workshop support, you can now play workshop maps, however it may be still very buggy!
This took me a long time to do, hopefully it will encourage people to use level editor more!

[h3][b]how 2 worksop?!?!??[/b][/h3]
1. Go to Start
2. Go to Funmode
3. Go to Custom Levels
4. Click "View Workshop" to download workshop levels
5. Then go to "Play Custom Levels" and select a level in the list.
6. Play level,[strike] give me playtime,[/strike] have fun

[h3][b]bacc 2 featurs[/b][/h3]
- Changed quite a bit of levels.
- Changed how the wheel spins (more rng)
- Wheel Cooldown decreases if the player wins levels (-20s in maingame, -10s in challenges)
- Made it more clear what the "cooldown" is.
- Translated some stuff
- Added more splash text
- Medal is added next to the timer when you win a workshop level

[h2][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h2]
- Fixed -1m wheel issue
- You can no longer exit out of the wheel screen when the wheel is spinning.
- Fixed scrolling in Custom Levels menu
- Placing Doors and Keys will now unverify the level from being published.
- Fixed some player particles not rendering properly

In 1.7.3, I think I'll work on hats, language support and maybe some additional support for workshop. Thank you :)

notes.title: Version Beta 1.7.1 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/93f478847591d598ad4185595b7e4dc3a44438a7.png[/img]

[b][h2]Welcome to the first regular update![/h2][/b]
This is the first regular update on steam, no need to update stuff manually anymore! Steam does it all for you, anyway onto the release notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/83db9024593f4db3e3809ac8efcff054e8c27848.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Features:[/h1][/b]
- New splash texts (9+10)
- Added level select screen, for now its extremely basic with only containing main game levels.
- Moved some buttons for less confusion
- Changed W5-L16 for balancing reasons
- Added invisible challenge (difficulty 1) and added it to endless run
- Added the credits wheel, [b]every hour of playtime[/b] you get a free spin, however you can pay credits if you want the [b]1 hour of playtime[/b] cooldown to be gone, also the lower the cooldown is, the lower the payment is. (And as always, no in app purchases)
- Checkpoints will now appear on the last two levels in main game, however casual still has more checkpoints.
- Added new maps in local multiplayer.
- Expanded German Language (Settings Info and Skin Description translated)
- Added exit button in main menu, cuz why not
- Checkpoints now save if you had a gun
- The King can now receive a critical hit from bullets if the king is midair (or if it lands on bullets from above)
- Made D.Jump-L9 Easier.
- Added Local Multiplayer Skins and Hats
- Nerfed 2nd part of W5-L20 in Main Game.
- Updated "The End" screen.
- King will now die if berserk cheat is on
- Nerfed Troop Cannon, it will spawn a maximum of 2 armored troops.
- Game updated to GMS 2.3.4, may have improvements.

[b][h1]Bugfixes:[/h1][/b] (Thanks dha)
- Fixed Player 3 in local multiplayer
- Fixed some rockets not destroying boxes properly or killing the player.
- A lot of checkpoint bugs
- Fix a crash when you beat the game on hardmode
- Fixed several music issues
- Fixed crash if you had berserk on (related to troops)
- You should no longer start at 24 ammo in boss 5 when you die in normal mode
- You won't get random coin achievements (+ some will be removed)
- Optimized + Fixed Boss 3 issue where you would pass through buttons.
- Fixed Crash in Local Multiplayer where it would crash if a player teleported
- Fixed Pirate Skin and Gordon Skin
- Steam wouldn't launch the game properly on Linux, specifically Arch (Thanks Monou and Sydew)
- And more!

[b][h2]Final Thing[/h2][/b]
Thank you for 50 sales within 2 weeks, I never launched a game on steam and I honestly expected worse, but I hope that I can continue to work on the game as much as I hope for you guys to continue to play The Colorful Creature. Lots more awesome stuff is coming, such as proper workshop support :)

Oh and also, prepare for 2022, and save up those god damn credits!

notes.title: TCC Beta 1.7 Change Log (HUGE UPDATE)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/bb833b7e94803ba788b8edd8191c04827e6ad87b.png[/img]

[h2][b]Before we start:[/b][/h2]

I wanna thank donators and supporters, friends and family for making TCC still in development. Without your help, the game would never be on Steam, so I am very happy you guys keep supporting the game. Let's hope to reach more newer players as the time goes on, and I'll try keep making awesome updates like these.

The reason why this change log took so long is because I haven't wrote it up until now!

Oh yeah, you are here for the [b]changelog[/b], well look no further!

If you want to see the 3rd Year Anniversary Special, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651680/view/2949283287693146958]click here.[/url]
One final thing, I will stop posting stuff on google documents, because I want to fully support the steam version. Here we go.

[h1]Features in Beta 1.7:[/h1]

[h2][b]Main Menu:[/b][/h2]

- Updated Title Screen
- Added new graphics on buttons, instead of being drawn as a image, now they are being drawn by code, they can now support multiple languages, text scaling, multiple colors, different types (locked/unlocked) and more!
- Added 100+ more splashtexts.

[h2][b]Achievements Menu:[/b][/h2]

- The Achievement Menu got an overhaul
- Added "Show Achievement Page" Button
- You cannot get steam achievements with cheats on.
- Things that the new achievements have:

1. Achievements are bigger!
2. Achievements have an individual icon!
3. You can now scroll to see more achievements!
4. Most Achievements are tied to Steam Achievements!
5. Secret Achievements Functionality Available!

- Added 77 New Achievements, 100 of which are Steam Achievements (will add more in the near future pls steam increase limit), and in total there are 117 Achievements in the game.
- All old achievements have been ported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/29b3a1e2632faed3e2453974e877c8e73ace6847.png[/img]

[h2][b]Settings Menu:[/b][/h2]

- Made title text animated in most menus (Previously it was only on the Title Screen)
- Added "Show Object Number" which is a special Level Editor setting which shows how many objects have been placed in the Level Editor.
- Added Casual Mode, casual mode is by default enabled in settings and it basically adds checkpoints to the game. When a checkpoint is reached, you'll respawn there when you die. Casual Mode while it changes the difficulty does not affect progress, so its not really a cheat but rather an accessibility feature.
- Added "Auto-Thumbnail" which makes a thumbnail of the Level Editor level automatically from time to time. Disable if you want to make custom thumbnails.
- Added "Old Gravity/Speed Numbers" setting which brings back the old sprites of gravity and speed items. Useful if arrows confuse you too much.
- You can now enable immunity mode cheat without having to grind for every single skin
- Added "No-Clip" cheat, reddie abuses all laws of physics and passes through blocks. Move by going left and right and ascend and descend by "jumping" and "interacting"
- If you enable any cheat, the game cannot save stats, challenge time and deaths, main game, and achievements. You have to restart the game to have them save again.
- Added "Berserk" cheat which kills all troops and bosses.
- Updated Existing Settings
- Grayscale Colorblind Improved

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/d17f74612df271fab89e8e801c3640011376e2bb.png[/img]

[h2][b]Support For Languages:[/b][/h2]

- Added 5 Languages in the Languages category in Settings:
English
German
French
Italian
And Spanish

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/a8a2fa8c68370fa5122b9131266dc9db88ea7fbf.png[/img]

[h3][b]y is it 2 slow??1?:[/b][/h3]

Languages are right now very primitive and needs time and effort (to understand why, it is because of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0j74jcxSunY]this[/url]). Luckily I have a team of translators helping me and that will hopefully improve the quality of the game in other languages. In the future 1.7.X versions you will see more support from these languages, mainly starting with German and then the rest. And of course more will come on their way!

- Right now one of the things translated for all languages are statistics, some of the title text and buttons,

[h2][b]Statistics:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Semi-Overhaul to stats screen, stuff is in more color and more viewable, new stats that tracks specific deaths:[/b][/h3]

Block Deaths
Restart Deaths
Spike Deaths
Invisible Spike Deaths
Vertical Moving Spike Deaths
Horizontal Moving Spike Deaths
Golden Spike Deaths
Weird Spike Deaths
Void Deaths
Set on Fire
Lava Deaths
Bullet Deaths
Rocket Deaths
Troop Deaths
Drowned

- Added Double Jump Pickups Stat
- Updated Various Stats (Like skin,hat stats etc)
- Added more ranks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/f48df113062ddfe16edbb9f9d3b2c7a6eeb51d64.png[/img]

[h2][b]Story Mode:[/b][/h2]

- Added 2 brand new bosses.
- New secrets and levels.
- Changed certain bad levels from previous versions.
- Hat Merchant has new dialog.
- Hat Merchant has more hats to sell.
- Changed Boss songs (For DMCA Reasons, Nintendon't)
- Added new backgrounds in some levels
- Coin Converter can now give maximum 300 credits instead of 250, with the following formula:
Old Formula: Credits = Coins * (2+(Coins * 0.005))
New Formula: Credits = Coins * (2+(Coins * 0.01))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/50b18f888f3122528ff1fce9c4e8cbf1aa401f1f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hard Mode:[/b][/h2]

- Balanced Eternal Suffering Difficulty a bit.
- New Levels have more hazards.
- New Bosses are buffed compared to Main Game in some way or another.
- Moreover, not much changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/abd9378ddf5f883e602f2af59e85aab4efab6d29.png[/img]

[h2][b]Blocks, Items, Level Editor:[/b][/h2]

- Added Double Jump Item, when collected, it lets you jump mid air. Cannot be stacked but when the second jump is used it can be reused again if the same item is collected once more.
- Added invisible variants of red, yellow, green, blue and white blocks. They work pretty much how invisible blocks work.
- Updated Sprites for ammo and infinite ammo.
- Added Checkpoints (Functionality Mentioned Above)
- Added Button Pages in Level Editor, so you can do more stuff in your levels.
- It's now possible to make custom music for your levels, for more information [url=https://discord.com/channels/599226898974900225/636961417492299808/858117685481177088]click here.[/url]
- Added Background Changer in Level Editor, you can now add backgrounds (not to be confused with block backgrounds).
- Add Star Direction Changer in Level Editor, you can rotate star direction at any angle you wish!

- Added Medal Config in Level Editor, you can configure Diamond Medal time and other Medals will copy the time of the diamond medal:
Diamond Medal = Chosen Time
Gold Medal = Diamond * 1.1
Silver Medal = Gold * 1.2
Bronze Medal = Silver * 1.3

- Rocket Cannons and Cannons can now snap onto the celling.
- Added Thumbnail Button in Level Editor. Take a quick pic ;)
- Added Publish in Level Editor. Publish your own levels in Steam Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/b48d287f345cadb55125c37fed1786aee8bbd543.png[/img]

[h2][b]Workshop:[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]While there is support for uploading and downloading levels, there is no way to play levels officially yet. So if you want to play custom levels please wait for few updates so we can add this feature :)[/b][/h3]

[b]In order to publish your level in the Steam Workshop, you need to:[/b]
1. Be connected to steam on a legit copy of your game
2. The level must have a player and a door placed
3. Complete the Level
4. Have cheats disabled
5. Diamond Medal Time must be the same or higher than your level completion time.

- Once you successfully pass the requirements, you need to read [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cFGoV2rOmb_vfs0akiIL7EBI0gFKBXNj1BAVvpdi5cI/edit?usp=sharing]TCC Workshop Rules[/url] and accept the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/workshoplegalagreement]Steam Subscriber Agreement.[/url] But regardless, if you are a bad little boy, you can just [url=https://discord.gg/GrYShTVGm4]join here.[/url]

[h2][b]Fun Mode:[/b][/h2]

- Added ??????? and online leaderboards buttons in Fun Mode (both WIP)
- Added 3 new challenges (One more is coming in Beta 1.7.1)
Challenges are Double Jump, Corrupted Spike and [strike]W-[b]#3?[/b]#?7 [/strike]Challenges.
- 6 New skins (Will add more is coming in Beta 1.7.1)
- 8 New Hats (Will add more is coming in Beta 1.7.1)
- Added new skins and hats in local multiplayer

[h2][b]Other:[/b][/h2]

- The code uses more switch/cases, allowing for more performance.
- Made certain fonts ASCII to support symbols in common languages.
- You can now press F12 to take a screenshot in game, the image with automatically have a name based on a date and will appear in Local Files
- If Beta 1.6 and prior was played, the game would create new folders in Local Files and move the save files in them, that way it is now way safer to load old versions of the game without the game's save files being corrupted!
- These folders are Custom, Save Files, Screenshots
- Added new discord rich presence stuff
- Changed how collision works with colored blocks (may be bugs)
- Made the hat merchant less hardcoded and more workable
- Stars support full 360 degree rotation
- Changed how medals work in challenges menu.
- Changed how selecting skins and hats works in Customization Menu
- The credits counter now has a black rectangle behind the balance

[h1]Bugfixes in Beta 1.7:[/h1]

- Visual bugs fixed (old school endless run highscore was weirdly centered sometimes)
- Fixed some lag issues
- Fixed spelling mistakes (Mostly in settings)
- Fixed some hitboxes in level editor when you are deleting/middle clicking items
- Fixed one sound that was missing in cache
- Code optimizations
- Fixed Texture Issues
- Level Editor a bit optimized
- Fixed ForsenE skin
- In local multiplayer, the particles were supposed to be spawned by players when they move, now that happens in this version.
- Fixed Music in Funmode
- Fixed Visual Bugs in Customization Menu
- Cleaned up bad player code
- Fixed Boss 3 buttons being stuck.
- Fixed big room challenge medal issue
- In "the end" the text at the top now becomes red if you are cheating
- [strike]I don't want to scroll through 5 months of various dev versions just assume that I've[/strike] Fixed Many Other Crashes and Bugfixes

notes.title: JULY 2021 NEWS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/2c2f1976c806dce6ca46be42475f05add3c78ff0.png[/img]

[b][h1]July 2021 TCC News![/h1][/b]
Hello everyone, it's about time that I'll finally show you guys one of the things I've been working on July, and there are even things that I planned on doing in beta 1.8 but were added in this version instead!

Before we get started, [b]reminder that the game will most likely come out in September![/b], so keep an eye out!

[b][h2]Level Editor Improvements[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/5eebd4133a19fea25153925d03757e2d5f488b44.png[/img]

During June and especially July I was working on the [b]Level Editor[/b], if you don't know the Level Editor in the game let's you create levels however you like! And the goal of this tool is to make it as close to make main-game levels as possible, and I think it's pretty close at doing that.

If you've played the [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/TCC/369194]free version[/url] of the game, you might've noticed quite a bit of new things, and you would be correct.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/b8eb2ce9e26ea9f39778ef14c452683b57c76a2a.png[/img]

When you load the level editor, you'll first notice these "arrows", those are [b]button pages[/b] (very creative name) and they let you go through the tools that the Level Editor offers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/1f431ce129f0f50ed21a2450664b6fc85cdab0be.png[/img]

Button Pages not only let me add more tools, but they also fixed the problem where I don't have to clump everything together in one bar.

In the second page, the first button is a background changer, it lets you change between backgrounds (just like how you change music).



The second button lets you change the angle direction of the stars at any angles, I had to rewrite star functionality to be able to do to that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/2b6570010ead4d3211e5b0695a93891222a3812c.png[/img]

The third button lets you change diamond medal time. And finally, the fourth button lets you publish your level to the [b]Steam Workshop!
[/b]
[b][h2]Steam Workshop Support[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/c61048b1154a32a0c126db863fc9c155448ffb86.png[/img]

That's right! [b]We're adding Steam Workshop to The Colorful Creature[/b], which is crazy because I wasn't planning on doing it in the first place, nobody asked me to do it in the first place, yet I did it and here I am. If you think I'm lying, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1651680/workshop/]just check the workshop itself.[/url]

So how does it work? Well before you can publish your level, you have to do the following things:

- Be connected on Steam and have it's API enabled.
- Have the player and the door placed.
- Don't make a change of the level after you've beaten it.
- Have diamond time be higher or the same than the time you completed the level.
- The level has to have a name.
- Cheats must be disabled.

Once you've fulfilled all of these requirements,[b] you're now ready to publish![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/30bdeaca802719ce954d074057e3c85cf37ec430.png[/img]

Before publishing, you have to [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cFGoV2rOmb_vfs0akiIL7EBI0gFKBXNj1BAVvpdi5cI/edit?usp=sharing]read the rules[/url] and agree to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/workshoplegalagreement]Steam Subscriber Agreement[/url] (For Legal Reasons).

If you've done everything correctly, your level will be published, and visible within the next minute! Congratulations for contributing in the future of gaming!

[b][h2]Custom Levels Menu[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/8febe0cba70f8c6aec1163578d5675c5cb1ca8f3.png[/img]

Custom Levels is a way to play your own Local Level Editor levels and your online Workshop levels. You basically click "Play Custom Levels", and you will immediately have a list of levels that you subscribed to and ready to play!

[b][h2]Achievement Menu Overhaul[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/29b3a1e2632faed3e2453974e877c8e73ace6847.png[/img]

In July I've overhauled the entire achievements menu, which brought confusion, was hard to work with, and it had tons of issues. So I've changed the entire look by adding a achievement icon, better progress bar, better title and description, and so on!

[b][h2]Thank You![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/5d366c56d6d316444f9b752f6aacd9fc42c8cca2.png[/img]

Well that's all for this month, see ya next month for the early access release of the game!
Make sure you guys wishlist the game on steam!

notes.title: The Store Page Is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/2f7573a34f39225988f0b794fb1838643d2fbb3b.png[/img]
[h1]Wishlist Release![/h1]
I am very honored to finally, after 1000 days of development, say that I got the game on Steam. This was highly requested from people who enjoyed playing the game, and I am so happy that I got to make this my first commercial game ever. This is a huge achievement for me.

I wanna thank the TCC Team for playtesting the dev versions of the game, dha and monst2r for their incredible performances with speedrunning the game, and pretty much everyone else playing the game!

[h1]So, Beta 1.7, what's the difference?[/h1]
I think it's about time to say what we are planning for the steam version of the game, I'm going to go over to the most important to the least important:

[h2]Main Game[/h2]
If you've "beaten" the game in the previous versions, in "The End" screen it says that the game isn't finished, which is true. We want to finish the main game, by adding the fourth and fifth boss, and adding something [i]very surprising[/i] at the end. You'll have to see what though! Not only that but some levels will have changes or complete overhauls, and also, there'll be fun little easter eggs!

[h2]Improved Graphics[/h2]
We plan adding graphical changes both to the game and main menu. Buttons will look super polished, graphically the game will have more backgrounds and particles. HUD will also have updated graphics and will hide this time if you are behind the HUD, as a quality of life improvement. Speaking of blocks, we don't plan changing the look of them, but I hope that I can add more variants to blocks, for example, bricks, but we will wait and see!

[h2]Online Leaderboards[/h2]
For challenges we plan adding online leaderboards, finally you'll be able to compete with players. The best players need to have the best time in order to get to the top!

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/aed4b0688057e2e77daceda50db8c1a64d88703f.png[/img]
We're adding steam achievements in unique icons. And we are also porting the in-game achievements as Steam Achievements, and to top it all off, the Achievement Menu will look less confusing and make more sense! If you happen to unlock achievements in the previous versions they will be unlocked on Steam immediately as soon as you [b]firstly[/b] launch the game.

[h2]Level Editor Improvements[/h2]
We plan adding a way to select items without having to scroll with your mouse (but you can still do it). We'll add an item menu which just let's you pick blocks and items without having to find it yourself. For selecting music, there'll be a menu for choosing music instead of repeatedly clicking the music button, and for loading levels, we plan adding a list of saved levels that are in Local Files. There is going to be a way to set the "diamond time" for each level, and finally we will also add a secondary way to try level editor levels, which is:

[h2]Custom Levels[/h2]
In Fun Mode, you will be able to just play a user made level without opening the level editor and playing it there. We hope to also add workshop support but that probably won't come immediately when the game's available to purchase.

[h2]New Skins and Hats[/h2]
You will be able to customize your player further, by adding an entire page of skins and hats. [i]Also, something is up with the Hat Merchant...[/i]

[h2]New Challenges[/h2]
When the game is available, there will be 5 new challenges to play. Which also have Beta 1.7 items and unlockable skins. Speaking of items...

[h2]Double Jump Item[/h2]
A double jump item is going to be added in the game. When Reddie collects this item it lets Reddie jump mid air. This item does not stack.

[h2]Improved Statistics[/h2]
You'll be able to see more statistics in the main menu! Mainly the deaths will be tracked.

[h2]Endless Run[/h2]
All endless run playthroughs should be more random since we are adding more levels, also, custom endless run will have a way to save a preset of settings, and share it to somebody who wants to try your challenge out. There will be a way to setup how much levels you need to beat to "complete" it, and there will be difficulty settings if you want the difficulty system to be enabled or not, if you want it enabled you can set the starting difficulty.

[h1]And more![/h1]
Remember that this is only Beta 1.7, there's more to come such as [b]THE CALENDAR[/b], new levels new skins new hats new challenges new endless run content new items coop mode for mulitplauyer new blocks ok bye thanks wishlist yes
